text: てのひらが　みずかきに　なっていて　およぐのが　とくい。

structure.jp: てのひらが　みずかきに　なっていて
structure.en: its palms have become webbing, and

patterns.name: 〜のが得意
patterns.span: およぐのが　とくい
patterns.explanation: の turns the action into a thing, and が とくい says someone is good at it. およぐのが　とくい = 'it is good at swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: みずかきに　なっていて
patterns.explanation: になる means 'become', and になっている describes how something is formed now. The final て links to the next part. みずかきに　なっていて = 'they are webbed, and'.
